sentences.text: Hmph. The data shows an unexpected temperature reading in the ironing room between 05:00 and 06:00.
The observed temperature of 21.6 °C was significantly higher than the expected range of 20.7 °C to 21.1 °C.
This sudden warmth with no source was probably caused by a simple appliance or perhaps a change in ambient air, rather than any spectral activity.
It is highly unlikely that a ghost caused this deviation from the expected 20.9 °C.
